_source: Verbatim UI strings from pototype/chrome.jsx + shell.jsx + company-accept.jsx that are NOT nav labels. Transcribed (never invented/re-translated) so they stay out of .tsx source (i18n-guard skips .json) and route through the i18n phrase layer tp(): th (the visual-gate language) renders the exact prototype text. After PLAT-03 (B-039(ก-ปรับ)) MOST of these Thai strings are now real phrase keys in i18n-full.json, so tp() resolves real en/zh/ar translations; the few not yet filled (companyPickTitle / companyTaxLabel / companyInfo — the un-omitted CompanySwitcher strings, BLOCKERS B-047; and notifEmpty is intentionally NOT here, B-045) fall back to the Thai key until Wei fills them, same fallback precedent as B-035/B-039. Strings that DO have a dict key (common.*/nav.*) are rendered with t()/tn() directly and are not duplicated here.
